title: Questions After the Way
summary: Nephi addresses his beloved brethren about what they ponder after entering the way, recalling that receiving the Holy Ghost enables them to speak with the tongue of angels.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi addresses his beloved brethren and says he supposes they ponder what to do after entering in by the way.
Nephi asks why they ponder these things in their hearts.
Nephi says he had told them that after receiving the Holy Ghost they could speak with the tongue of angels.
Nephi says speaking with the tongue of angels is by the Holy Ghost.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi is visibly speaking to the brethren he addresses.
unspecified_visual_details: The setting, clothing, ages, and appearance of Nephi and the brethren are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: But, behold, why do ye ponder these things in your hearts?
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

spoken_dialogue.text: Do ye not remember that I said unto you that after ye had received the Holy Ghost ye could speak with the tongue of angels?
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The tongue of angels is discussed as teaching; no angels are shown as a visual event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict angels speaking or the Holy Ghost visibly appearing; neither is narrated as a visible event here.

title: Feast Upon the Words
summary: Nephi teaches that angels speak by the power of the Holy Ghost and that Christ's words tell the hearers what to do. He says they must ask and knock to be brought into the light.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi says angels speak by the power of the Holy Ghost and speak the words of Christ.
Nephi tells his hearers to feast upon the words of Christ, which will tell them what they should do.
Nephi says failure to understand will be because they ask not and knock not, and that they are not brought into the light but must perish in the dark.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi continues speaking to the brethren he addresses.
unspecified_visual_details: The setting and the appearance of the speakers and hearers are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: Angels speak by the power of the Holy Ghost; wherefore, they speak the words of Christ.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

spoken_dialogue.text: feast upon the words of Christ;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

spoken_dialogue.text: if ye cannot understand them it will be because ye ask not, neither do ye knock;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Light and dark are used in a teaching about understanding and seeking; do not depict them as a literal transformation or supernatural event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show angels, a literal feast of written words, or a supernatural light or darkness as an event.

title: The Doctrine of Christ
summary: Nephi teaches that the Holy Ghost will show those who enter in by the way what to do. He identifies this as the doctrine of Christ and says his hearers should observe what Christ will say when he manifests himself to them in the flesh.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi says that if his hearers enter in by the way and receive the Holy Ghost, it will show them what they should do.
Nephi calls this the doctrine of Christ and says there will be no more doctrine given until Christ manifests himself to them in the flesh.
Nephi says they should observe the things Christ will say when he manifests himself to them in the flesh.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi continues his teaching to the brethren.
unspecified_visual_details: The setting and appearance of the speakers and hearers are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: Behold, this is the doctrine of Christ,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

spoken_dialogue.text: the things which he shall say unto you shall ye observe to do.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Christ's future manifestation is referred to in Nephi's teaching, not narrated as happening in this scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Christ appearing in the flesh in this scene.

title: Nephi Mourns
summary: Nephi cannot say more because the Spirit stops his utterance. He is left to mourn because of men's unbelief, wickedness, ignorance, and stiffneckedness.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi says he cannot say more because the Spirit stops his utterance.
Nephi says he is left to mourn because of men's unbelief, wickedness, ignorance, and stiffneckedness.
Nephi says men will not search knowledge or understand great knowledge when it is given plainly.

unspecified_visual_details: The location, Nephi's appearance, and his exact manner of mourning are unspecified.

narration.text: And now I, Nephi, cannot say more; the Spirit stoppeth mine utterance, and I am left to mourn

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse states that the Spirit stops Nephi's utterance but does not describe a visible appearance or mechanism.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a visible Spirit or invent a physical manifestation.
Do not depict the people Nephi describes as physically present.

title: The Need to Pray
summary: Nephi perceives that his beloved brethren still ponder, says it grieves him to speak concerning this thing, and teaches them to pray always and to pray to the Father in the name of Christ before performing anything unto the Lord.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi addresses his beloved brethren, perceives that they still ponder in their hearts, and says it grieves him to speak concerning this thing.
Nephi says the Spirit teaches a person to pray, while the evil spirit teaches a person not to pray.
Nephi says his hearers must pray always and not faint.
Nephi says they must pray to the Father in the name of Christ before performing anything unto the Lord, so that their performance may be consecrated for the welfare of their soul.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi may be shown speaking; his beloved brethren are the people he addresses, but the verses do not establish their physical presence in a depicted setting.
unspecified_visual_details: The location, the appearance of Nephi and his hearers, and the hearers' visible actions are unspecified.
